note: 'if I go, I will send Him to you' (John 16:7), and at 15:26 'whom I will send unto you from the Father'. Marked implied because John 16:7 says only 'I will send him' -- the speaker is named at 14:26, 'whom the Father will send in my name', which is the same discourse and the verse that names all three.
